title: Who goes first when two levels tie? Introductory text to A first-order Madelung tie-break on the round four-sphere: Kelvin parity, convex order and the Thomas-Fermi field
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on a first-order tie-break for the Madelung filling order on the round four-sphere. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
